## ⚠️ Security Report

**DO NOT** disclose sensitive details publicly. Please email the maintainer instead.

See [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) for responsible disclosure process.

This issue template should only be used for:
- Non-sensitive security questions
- General security best practices discussion
- Documentation of already-public security info

For actual vulnerability reports, email the maintainer directly.
